I graded submission s1 for quiz 0001 and wrote the grades to `grades/0001-s1.json`. Two items were correct, two partial and two wrong.

| Item | Verdict | Note |
|---|---|---|
| q1 | correct | |
| q2 | wrong | You chose (a), that the model opens the booking system itself (M4). |
| q3 | correct | |
| q4 | wrong | You answered 1, with the model running the 3 tools itself (M4, same mistake as q2). The answer is 4. |
| q5 | partial | The "send it back to the model" part is right, but the why is missing. |
| q6 | partial | Tool descriptions are right. The claim that it remembers tool choices across sessions is wrong (M3). |

You have the agent loop (q1) and the step limit (q3), and you know the model picks tools from their descriptions (q6). The belief to change is that the model runs tools itself (q2, q4). It only writes a request, and the program runs the tool.

**Next step:** Trace "Is the laser cutter free tomorrow?" through the loop. For each step, write down whether the model or the program acts and what text passes between them.

The `grade-reviewer` agreed with all six verdicts and misconception ids. It made four findings, all asking for a "Try first:" question on the `correct` and `wrong` items. I declined them because the grade skill allows that question only on `partial` items. I made no revision, so I ran no second pass. The review record is `review-records/0001-s1-grade.md`.

I also added learning record `0003-model-requests-program-runs-tools.md` and updated `NOTES.md`. I haven't graded `s2`.
